# Task Manager for addons - Find out which addon is slowing down your game
`/nap` , `/addonprofiler` or click the minimap button to toggle the UI
With patch 11.0.7, blizzard added in-depth information on addon performance, but the UI they added in 11.1 leaves a lot to be desired.
Various addons that show CPU usage use an old approach, which severely impacts your performance. The approach used by this addon has none of those problems.
This addon will display all the information you could ever wish for!*

...

1. Active Mode - actively records performance of all addons every frame, which allows creating the most thorough summaries, at the cost of some memory and CPU usage.
2.
Performance Mode - records far less information to improve background CPU usage, but reduces the granularity of information. Time based historical information will no longer be available.
3.
Passive Mode - absolutely nothing happens in the background, no information is gathered. This limits the information you can see, but can be helpful if you have an especially slow system and even performance mode costs too much CPU time.
